mods.name: Hearthlink
mods.description: An even better way to play Minecraft!

releases.notes:
Automated build of Hearthlink 0.8.6+1.21.11 for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric), commit 3a0f3cf.

Download `hearthlink-0.8.6+1.21.11.jar` and put it in your instance's `mods/` folder next to Fabric API. It needs Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.20 or newer (built against 0.20.1) and Java 25.

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `hearthlink-0.8.6+1.21.11.jar` | The mod. |
| `hearthlink-0.8.6+1.21.11-sources.jar` | Source jar. |
| `hearthlink-0.8.6+1.21.11.jar.sha256` | SHA-256 checksum of the mod jar. |

Install steps per launcher are in the [user guide](https://github.com/PimWilTaart125/heartlink/blob/mc-1.21.11/USER_GUIDE.md).

readmeSummary: Hearthlink is a client-side Minecraft Java mod (Fabric) that adds player-hosted multiplayer, friends and chat, and an in-game skin changer.
